findings.summary: S12.5 is satisfied by engine-side enforcement plus a sidecar artifact rather than a literal additive change to the sealed review-result schema: the vendored plugin schema is pinned byte-for-byte (additionalProperties:false) and cannot admit checked/verified_items, so the engine refuses a receipt lacking the checklist at ingestion (INVALID_HANDOFF_SCHEMA, red-able) and persists checked_items/verified_items for both phases in continuous/final-review-sidecar.json at the seal edge -- the spec's own 'review.json 或其旁挂工件' channel. Every red-able S12.5 criterion in the spec passes; recorded as a note because the durable checklist lives beside review.json, not inside it.

The M1 wake entry handle_dd_awaiting_gate_wake remains library-level: no production scheduler/goal-line module invokes it (no caller outside fleet_graph.self_gate in src/). Unchanged from the lineage's accepted attempt-1 form, which the continuous review approved as a note; the scheduler's dd_awaiting_gate wake ignition is the production trigger, and the instance-target line (runner.py:489) is pinned red-able by the frozen acceptance, so the wiring defect class S12 exists to catch is covered.
